analysis_role: Post-result falsification of the already-supported transition-regime hypothesis. Keep the exact same (+BIO15,-BIO1) estimator and test whether the result depends on relaxed occurrence coverage or Taiwan/Japan composition.

fixed_hypothesis.estimator: identical CTMC edge-joint posterior x Brownian branch-shift composite implemented in analysis/run_chapter2_orientation_transition_regime_hypothesis_v1.py

strict_n10.question: Does H1 remain exceptional when only taxa meeting the original frozen n>=10 occurrence gate are used?

japan_n5.question: Does H1 remain exceptional after Taiwan taxa are removed, using only the already-frozen Japan occurrence artifact at n>=5?

decision_rule.panel_pass: observed composite is positive on all six topologies and exact one-sided count-preserving state-map fraction <=0.05
decision_rule.note: These are robustness classifications for an already-observed result, not independent preregistered replications.

claim_ceiling: Do not change the environmental vector or add predictors after result inspection.
Exact map fractions are finite randomization ranks, not biological-replicate P values.
Japan-only persistence is regional robustness, not an independent evolutionary replication.
A robust result still does not identify historical climate causation, selection, adaptation, or a mediator.
